mapper.update: UPDATE article_index_outbox SET status='completed',lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)>0 FROM article_index_outbox WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND article_id=#{articleId} AND status='completed'

SELECT job_id,article_id,action,routing_key,attempts FROM article_index_outbox WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND ((status IN ('pending','dispatched') AND available_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status='running' AND lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT job_id FROM article_index_outbox WHERE (status IN ('pending','dispatched') AND available_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status='running' AND lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY available_at,created_at LIMIT 16
